description: Foundation: upgrade motion, fix globals.css, rewrite providers+layout with new ThemeProvider and SSR cookie support, create SnackbarContext helper, update use-toast, delete old lib/theme.ts. Every subsequent FEAT depends on this being done first.
steps: 1. Update apps/web/package.json: change `"motion": "^12.0.0"` → `"motion": "^14.0.0"`. Then from /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata run `pnpm install`.

2. Update /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/src/app/globals.css: replace `@import "@vkieu/mui/theme.css";` with `@import "@vkieu/mui/styles.css";`, remove the `@import "@vkieu/mui/themes/theme-facebook.css";` line. Change `.dark ::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator { filter: invert(1); }` selector to `[data-mode='dark'] ::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator { filter: invert(1); }`.

3. Create /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/src/lib/snackbar.ts with SnackbarContext = createContext<SnackbarHostState | null>(null) and exported useSnackbar() hook. Import SnackbarHostState type from @vkieu/mui.

4. Rewrite /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/src/app/providers.tsx as a 'use client' component. Remove the old manual ThemeContext/ThemeProvider/localStorage/matchMedia logic. Import ThemeProvider, SnackbarHost, useSnackbarHostState, createTheme from @vkieu/mui; import QueryClient/QueryClientProvider from @tanstack/react-query; import SnackbarContext from @/lib/snackbar. Define `const facebookTheme = createTheme({ name: 'facebook', seed: '#1877F2' })` at module scope. In Providers: call `const snackbarState = useSnackbarHostState();`. Render: QueryClientProvider > ThemeProvider(themes=['baseline',facebookTheme], defaultTheme='facebook', storage='cookie') > SnackbarContext.Provider(value=snackbarState) > SnackbarHost(state=snackbarState) + children.

5. Rewrite /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx as an async server component. Add `import { cookies } from 'next/headers';` and `import { NextRouterProvider, getThemeFromCookies, themeAttributes } from '@vkieu/mui/next';`. Read `const theme = getThemeFromCookies(await cookies(), { themes: ['baseline', 'facebook'], defaults: { theme: 'facebook', mode: 'system' } });`. Spread `{...themeAttributes(theme)}` on `<html>`. Wrap `<Providers>` with `<NextRouterProvider>` inside `<body>`.

6. Delete /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/src/lib/theme.ts. It is no longer needed after providers.tsx no longer uses ThemeContext and all callers (sidebar.tsx) are updated in FEAT-003.

7. Update /Users/xuan-manh.trinh/workplace/web/strata/apps/web/src/hooks/use-toast.ts: change `import { useSnackbar } from '@vkieu/mui'` → `import { useSnackbar } from '@/lib/snackbar'`. Change `snackbar.show({...})` → `snackbar.showSnackbar({...})`. Map durations: `duration: 4000` → `duration: 'short'`; `duration: 6000, priority: 'urgent', showClose: true` → `duration: 'long', withDismissAction: true`.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter @strata/web build exits 0 after all 7 steps
globals.css contains @import '@vkieu/mui/styles.css' and does NOT contain @vkieu/mui/theme.css or theme-facebook.css
layout.tsx is async and calls getThemeFromCookies
findings: All 7 steps implemented. pnpm install updated motion to ^14.0.0. globals.css now imports @vkieu/mui/styles.css (not theme.css). lib/snackbar.ts created with SnackbarContext + useSnackbar. providers.tsx rewrites with ThemeProvider(themes=['baseline',facebookTheme], defaultTheme='facebook', storage='cookie')+SnackbarHost. layout.tsx is async with getThemeFromCookies + themeAttributes on <html>. lib/theme.ts deleted. use-toast.ts uses showSnackbar with 'short'/'long' durations. sidebar.tsx @/lib/theme import was patched to use useTheme from @vkieu/mui (theme/mode/setMode). FEAT-003 should note: (1) sidebar.tsx still uses removed Icon + old Tooltip API — these are pre-existing errors to fix in FEAT-003; (2) the pnpm install created a new peer-dep hash for @vkieu/mui (_pl7w) that lacked dist — dist was copied from the old installation (_trdf); any future pnpm install may need this fix repeated; (3) build still has 408 pre-existing errors from old API usage (@vkieu/mui/buttons subpath, removed Icon/Typography/Select/CardContent/etc.) — all in feature/component files outside FEAT-001 scope; (4) ThemeProvider now uses data-mode attribute instead of .dark class for dark mode; (5) createTheme requires { name, seed } — facebookTheme is generated at runtime.
